jobs.jobDescription:
The role

You will build and improve the WebCompat team’s internal tooling, the dashboards and the broken-site-report screenshot pipeline the team relies on to triage and prioritize site breakage. This is a focused tooling role that makes the WebCompat program faster and more data-driven.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve WebCompat dashboards (triage, reporting, and metrics).
  • Improve the broken-site-report screenshot capture and pipeline.
  • Work with the WebCompat team (including QA) to turn reporting and triage needs into reliable tooling.

Required qualifications

  • Solid web development (JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python & Django) and experience building dashboards / data views.
  • Comfort with tooling, automation, and web services.
  • Self-directed, with good written communication.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with WebCompat workflows and Bugzilla.
  • Experience with screenshot / automation pipelines.
  • Experience with Machine Learning

jobs.jobDescription:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced AI Solutions Engineer to help build an AI-powered IT Help Desk Automation platform using AWS Bedrock and modern serverless technologies.

This role focuses on designing intelligent automation workflows that leverage AI agents to streamline IT operations, including ticket triage, request routing, and identity/access management automation across enterprise systems.

The ideal candidate combines strong Python development skills with hands-on experience building AI-powered applications using AWS Bedrock and modern AWS serverless services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop AI-powered automation solutions using AWS Bedrock.
  • Build and orchestrate AI agents capable of handling IT help desk workflows.
  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms using REST APIs.
  • Implement automation for ticket triage, routing, and access request workflows.
  • Build serverless applications using AWS Lambda and Step Functions.
  • Integrate AI workflows with KACE, Okta, Azure AD, and similar enterprise platforms.
  • Design secure, scalable, and maintainable cloud-native solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to continuously improve AI agent performance.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong Python development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services.
  • Experience building cloud-native applications.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems using REST APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Must Have:

  • Strong Python development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock.
  • Experience building AI Agents.
  • Experience with:
    • Bedrock Agents
    • Action Groups
    • Guardrails
    • Experience developing serverless applications using:
      • AWS Lambda
      • AWS Step Functions
      • Experience integrating enterprise systems through REST APIs.
      • Experience with identity and access management integrations.
      • Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
      • Strong understanding of Generative AI application development.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Experience integrating with:
    • Okta
    • Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)
    • KACE
    • Experience with enterprise ITSM platforms.
    • Experience with authentication and identity management.
    • Experience with Amazon API Gateway.
    • Experience with EventBridge or SQS.
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code.
    • Experience with prompt engineering.
    • Experience optimizing AI agent workflows.

    • Compensation

    Additional Information

    Benefits & Perks:

    Home office;

    Competitive compensation based on experience;

    Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;

    International Projects;

    Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);

    Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass;

    Games and Competitions;

    You can also apply here:

    Website: https://www.oowlish.com/work-with-us/

    LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/oowlish/jobs/
